description: Source code implementing the gl::Renderbuffer class and related functionality for OpenGL ES 2.0, including state management, storage setup, and rendering support.

classes.name: RenderbufferState
classes.description: Manages the state of a renderbuffer, including size, format, samples, and initialization state.

classes.name: Renderbuffer
classes.description: Implements a renderer-agnostic OpenGL renderbuffer object, handling storage, labels, and attachment details.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Sets the storage format and size for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Sets multisample storage for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: setStorageEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Associates an EGL image as the storage target for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the format of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the approximate memory size of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the renderbuffer.
